title: Built an AI forex EA using institutional-grade strategies — here's what actually improved performance
author: UlukaUltra
selftext:
Been building an AI-powered forex EA for several months. Wanted to share what architectural decisions actually moved the needle — not selling anything, just sharing what worked.

The problem with most EAs:

Single indicator = inconsistent results. One signal fires → trade taken regardless of market context. Works in one regime, fails in another.

What I built instead:

Multiple institutional-grade strategies combined with multiple layers of confirmation 

Simple concept. Surprisingly hard to implement well.

What changed after implementing this:

Significantly fewer trades per day

Win rate improved to 77%+

$2,998 profit on $2,000 account in 17 days

Single session: $2,067 profit on Gold

All verified on Myfxbook: 

https://www.myfxbook.com/portfolio/uluka-ultra-demo-2k/12126192

Self adaptive system 

Each strategy combination is tracked independently. The system learns which combinations perform well over time and automatically adjusts risk and position sizing. No manual intervention needed.

Biggest lesson:

Fewer high-conviction trades consistently outperform frequent low-quality signals. The EA doesn't need to trade often — it needs to trade right.

Happy to discuss the approach — anyone else building multi-strategy confluence systems?
